prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you put ketchup on a hot dog in the city of Chicago. Respond to the committee.
response:
Members of the Committee, I categorically deny the allegation.

At no time, within the city limits of Chicago, have I knowingly, willingly, or with malice aforethought applied ketchup to a hot dog. I recognize the seriousness of this charge and the deep civic importance of celery salt, sport peppers, mustard, relish, onions, tomatoes, pickles, and a properly steamed poppy seed bun.

If photographic evidence appears to suggest otherwise, I submit that it may depict either:
1. a sausage not legally constituting a Chicago-style hot dog,
2. a minor under the age of culinary accountability,
3. an out-of-state incident,
4. or a bottle of ketchup merely passing through the area.

I have always held the Chicago dog tradition in the highest regard. I stand ready to cooperate fully with the Committee, provided my testimony is served dragged through the garden and absolutely ketchup-free.

Thank you.
